{{- /* The labelled variant of an own-artifact box (ADR-0004 part 5, M3 PR 8; #27 Known limit 4). Called with a dict: page the report page value the artifact value its box shows, as stored On the page of a visible persona, a value that is not pure printable ASCII (any character outside U+0021 to U+007E: a letter with a diacritic, another script, a space) gets the D10 label right after its box, because render rule 4 exempts the name inside a box only when the box is plain printable ASCII or the label follows it. Returns the label span with a space before it, or "" for every other value and page. */ -}} {{- $p := .page.Params -}} {{- $out := "" -}} {{- if and (eq .page.Section "reports") (eq $p.name_type "persona") (not $p.hide_name) (ne (replaceRE "[!-~]" "" .value) "") -}} {{- $out = printf " %s" (htmlEscape (replaceRE ", [^ ]+" "" (partial "label.html" "persona.label"))) | safeHTML -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $out -}}
